name: Nessa Shadowsong
summary: In Darnassus, Mydrannul sends a courier to meet Nessa Shadowsong below the World Tree. The delivery runs from Rut'theran Village to Darkshore, linking the canopy city with the shore.

sections.title: A Errand Beyond the Canopy
sections.body: Mydrannul watches over travelers seeking work and purpose in Darnassus. Fishing merchant Nessa Shadowsong needs a package carried across the sea to Darkshore, so Mydrannul directs able couriers toward the coast. Many young night elves begin their journeys among Teldrassil's boughs; this delivery takes them beyond the tree.

sections.title: Descending to the Docks
sections.body: From the Temple Gardens, the western portal in Darnassus leads down through the World Tree to Rut'theran Village. At the ocean-level roots, fishing docks and hippogryph perches connect Teldrassil with the rest of Kalimdor. Nessa Shadowsong tends her trade there and prepares shipments for Auberdine.

aliases: where to get nessa shadowsong quest
faq.answer: Mydrannul offers the delivery in Darnassus, in the Warrior's Terrace.

faq.q: How do I get to Rut'theran Village?
faq.answer: Go west from the Temple Gardens and step through the large, glowing tree portal. It carries you down to Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil.
Nessa Shadowsong is a fishing supplier at the docks of Rut'theran Village. She oversees goods and parcels moving between Teldrassil and Darkshore.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead?
faq.answer: Speaking with Nessa leads to 'The Bounty of Teldrassil'. It introduces the flight master and provides your first flight across the water to Auberdine.

faq.q: Is Nessa related to Maiev Shadowsong?
faq.answer: Nessa and Maiev Shadowsong share a surname, but no personal connection between them is recorded. Nessa is a dockside fishing merchant, while Maiev is a legendary warden.

faq.q: Why is this errand important for young adventurers?
faq.answer: This journey teaches young adventurers how to leave the crown of Teldrassil, reach the docks below, and use hippogryph flight paths to reach mainland Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a night elf, you leave Darnassus's heights for the coastal routes linking your home with Darkshore's ancient shores.
As an Alliance adventurer, you learn how Teldrassil connects with the other Alliance territories on Kalimdor.
